scope: 按现有 production-internal-test 配置以 CI/CD 首次部署 Xboard，保护同机 Remnawave
findings: Docker 29.8.0 / Compose v5.5.1 / Linux amd64 可用，部署目录不存在
my2.thinderbox.uk 已是 Remnawave 反向代理域名，等待用户选择独立入口
80/8443 由现有 Caddy 占用，443 由 rw-core 占用；不接管这些监听
凭据按用户现有 Variables 存储使用，禁止在 workflow env/with/run 插值中展开私钥，避免步骤日志泄漏
独立后台管理路径不等于完整子路径部署；当前安装器不接受带路径的 PANEL_URL，同域名需要先完成完整子路径兼容，不能覆盖现有 Remnawave 路由。

tasks.title: 只读服务器、SSH 主机身份与端口巡检
实现受保护 main 手动首次部署流水线，严格主机校验和日志脱敏
在独立目录/Compose 项目/端口启动 CI 验证镜像，拒绝覆盖和冲突
验证精确版本、访问入口与 Remnawave 容器未被重建重启

non_goals: 不修改 Remnawave 数据、容器、网络和现有路由
不通过本地 SSH 上传代码或执行部署
route_plan: App binds 127.0.0.1:7080 on its own Compose network. Existing Caddy joins only this new network and gets one marked fast.hjy.ca site; validate and reload without restarting existing containers. Existing Remnawave sites and network remain intact.
rollback: On failed installation/public health, remove only the marked Xboard Caddy block, detach its new Caddy network connection and stop only the Xboard app; retain its data/credentials. Never delete existing data or restart Remnawave.
checks: Python input validation: 3 tests passed including subcases rejecting shell injection, wrong directory and subpath
Branch push performs read-only preflight only; installation requires manual protected-main dispatch
